[9/14/26, 7:38:12 PM] Anjali Desai: Hi! Can you send this out tonight please

NAVRATRI GARBA NIGHT 2026

Please join us for our biggest event of the year. We’ll have live music,
a full dandiya floor, and dinner catered by Surati Farsan. Doors open at
six and the garba starts at seven sharp, so please try to arrive early
because parking fills up fast on the​ Redondo Beach side.

Kids under ten are free. We are also look­ing for six volunteers to help
with setup and two more for cleanup afterwards.

When: Saturday, October 10 at 6:00 pm
Where: Torrance Cultural Arts Center, 3330 Civic Center Dr
Cost: $30 per adult, $15 per child, under 10 free
RSVP: https://example.org/garba-2026?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&id=4417&fbclid=IwAR2x

• bring your own dandiya sticks if you have them
• wear traditional dress, prizes for best chaniya choli
- carpool if you can, parking is tight
- cash or Zelle at the door, no cards

Questions: anjali.desai@example.org or call the hall at www.example.org/contact

Thanks everyone!
